subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should this issue be split so Feishu outbound hook parity is fixed first, while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening remains a separate plugin API/security decision?
rationale: The outbound hook bypass is a documented rewrite/cancel/audit bug, but normal-channel claiming changes plugin authority and routing order across channel traffic, so automation should not choose that boundary.

options.title: Split Outbound Parity From Inbound Claim
options.body: Fix Feishu `message_sending`/`reply_payload_sending`/`message_sent` parity through the dispatcher/outbound hook seam and keep normal-channel `inbound_claim` on a separate review track.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Hook Umbrella
options.body: Move the remaining Feishu outbound evidence under the broader configured-dispatcher hook reports and keep this issue only as Feishu-specific acceptance context.

options.title: Solve All Hook Requests Together
options.body: Use one larger design PR for Feishu outbound parity and normal-channel claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security-review cost.

recommendation.title: Split Outbound Parity From Inbound Claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu `message_sending`/`reply_payload_sending`/`message_sent` parity through the dispatcher/outbound hook seam and keep normal-channel `inbound_claim` on a separate review track.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on plugin-hook semantics and the issue discussion already routes the final plugin-surface call to this owner area.
